learning_objective: 🎯 Discover the magic of mixing different arts together, like adding music to a play or dancing while painting, to create something extraordinary!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Integration means combining two or more things to make one awesome project. Imagine a theatre play without background music or costumes; it would be boring! Art forms are meant to be mixed.
When a dancer, a musician, and a painter work together, they collaborate. The painter designs the stage, the musician plays the beat, and the dancer tells the story through movement.
Movies are the best example of integrated arts. They mix acting (theatre), set design (visual arts), singing (music), and choreography (dance) to create a magical world for the audience.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 The Sound Drawing Game
fun_activity.instructions: Play a fast, happy song and use bright colors to draw whatever comes to your mind. Then, switch to a slow, relaxing song and draw with cool colors. See how the music changes your visual art!

quick_recap: ⭐ Integration is the exciting process of blending different art forms together.
⭐ Visual arts, music, dance, and theatre work best when they support each other.
⭐ Collaboration happens when artists from different fields team up to create a masterpiece.
⭐ Movies and theatre plays are perfect examples of multiple arts combined into one.
